newsitem.title: UK: Premier Oil signs Burma gas contract.
newsitem.headline: Premier Oil signs Burma gas contract.

text.p: British oil and gas company Premier Oil Plc said on Thursday it had signed a gas sales agreement with the governments of Burma and Thailand to supply gas from Burma's Yetagun field to Thailand.

Under the terms of the deal, commercial production is scheduled to start in late 1999 or early 2000 at a minimum initial rate of 200 million cubic feet per day for 15 years, together with some 6,000 barrels per day of associated condensate production.
The deal also allows for production rates to be increased up to 400 million cubic feet per day and the life of the contract to be extended to 25 years.

Premier holds 25.78 percent in the project. Other companies participating are Texaco Exploration Myanmar, Nippon Oil Exploration Myanmar and the Petroleum Authority of Thailand Exploration and Production Company
